title: You are choosing what class {name} sees
hint: Click a tower, a path section, a fork or a signpost to hide or show it. Grey and dashed — the class does not see it.
addedBase: Also added the towers this tower requires: {count}.
wholeStoryHidden: This section has no steps of its own — the whole story is hidden.
storyReopened: This section lay behind a hidden part — the whole story is shown again.
forkHidden: Hid the paths leaving this fork: {count}.
forkShown: Showed the paths leaving this fork: {count}.
tabSays: Click towers, path sections, forks and signposts on the map to show or hide them for {name}. Grey ones only the teacher sees. Finish with “Save for the class”.
tabRead: This is how {name} sees the world.
saved: Saved — the class now sees only what is in colour.
presets: Presets — click one to give this world to the class:
presetsNone: No presets yet. Save what is in colour as a preset to give it to a class later with one click.
presetNew: Save the selection as a preset
presetDropAsk: Delete the preset “{name}”? Classes that were given it keep their world.
